data.description:
## What
Remove the PASS_NUM>=2 cycle-count-based ratchet and MAX_ATTEMPTS->deep upgrade from REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md (and REVIEW-WORKFLOW-HUGE.md if present). Tier upgrades should happen only via ESCALATE_REVIEW signals from the reviewer.

## Changes
1. REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md: remove any block that reads REVIEW_PASS_NUM >= 2 and upgrades light->standard or standard->deep. Remove any post-loop 'MAX_ATTEMPTS->deep' escalation block.
2. REVIEW-WORKFLOW-HUGE.md: search for same ratchet patterns and remove them.
3. Add oscillation short-circuit doc: when 2 consecutive Call 2 redispatches produce the same set of proximity overlaps (same file+line pairs), skip further Call 2 redispatch.
4. Document that tier upgrade ONLY via ESCALATE_REVIEW signal.

## Acceptance Criteria
- grep -q 'REVIEW_PASS_NUM' REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md -> no PASS_NUM>=2 ratchet blocks remain
- Oscillation short-circuit documented
- make lint passes
data.title: UPDATE: remove PASS_NUM>=2 ratchet from REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md; tier upgrades via ESCALATE_REVIEW signals only
